name: AEC Codex
shortDescription: Set up and safely control local AutoCAD and Revit sessions.
longDescription: AEC Codex connects Codex to AutoCAD 2024 and Revit 2024 on the same Windows PC. It performs a read-only setup check, installs a checksum-pinned per-user host only after explicit approval, discovers structured CAD/BIM tools, previews writes, and uses native transaction or undo behavior for bounded changes.
starterPrompts: Set up AEC Codex on this PC and verify the local Autodesk connectors.
Inspect the active AutoCAD drawing without changing it.
Preview a safe Revit or AutoCAD change before executing it.
